functional_completeness.rationale: Public facade surface is contracted via schemas (ao-ma-* artifact families); completeness is gated by CI tests.

functional_correctness.rationale: Fail-closed governance pipelines enforce correctness; the test suite pins behavior across 5000+ tests.

functional_appropriateness.rationale: Each AO-MA slice is reviewed by an independent provider (Codex) before merge to confirm the scope fits the stated goal.

time_behaviour.rationale: Streaming + circuit breaker + rate limiter bound LLM call latency; benchmark-fast job tracks regressions per PR.

resource_utilization.rationale: Run governor enforces explicit budget caps (slices, retries, tokens, wall_clock); breaches halt the run.

capacity.rationale: ao-kernel is an embedded SDK/CLI; no service-tier capacity model. Operator-defined budget envelopes own scaling.

co_existence.rationale: Pure-Python library with no daemon, exclusive resource, or stateful host install. Cohabitation is the default.

interoperability.rationale: MCP server + JSONL evidence + schema-bound artifacts are the canonical interop surface; tests pin the wire shapes.

appropriateness_recognizability.rationale: Public CLI subcommands carry self-describing --help; SDK signatures are typed and documented.

learnability.rationale: CLAUDE.md + .claude/plans/ master plan + per-slice plan docs constitute the learning surface for new contributors.

operability.rationale: ao-kernel doctor + ao-kernel evidence subcommands let operators inspect workspace state without code reading.

user_error_protection.rationale: Fail-closed schema validation rejects malformed inputs before any side effect; CLI flags use argparse choices.

user_engagement.rationale: Developer-tool surface; no end-user-facing engagement loops within scope.

inclusivity.rationale: Text-only CLI/SDK with no UI; accessibility concerns live in any downstream UI built on top.

user_assistance.rationale: Error messages are gate-authored, secret-redacted, and include the failing path + invariant name; --help text is canonical.

self_descriptiveness.rationale: Public facade modules carry docstrings explaining the contract; bundled schemas describe every artifact field.

faultlessness.rationale: AST import-allowlist + fail-closed gates + 85%+ branch coverage on hot paths reduce defect leakage.

availability.rationale: Embedded SDK/CLI with no long-running service in the shipped boundary; availability is the host's concern.

fault_tolerance.rationale: Circuit breaker per provider + retry only before streaming + atomic file writes (tmp+fsync+rename) keep partial failures contained.

recoverability.rationale: Checkpoint + resume + canonical decision store let workflows recover from corruption without data loss; tests pin the round trip.

confidentiality.rationale: Notifier-grade secret redaction (10+ leak patterns) is applied to every free-text field before it enters an artifact.

integrity.rationale: SHA-bound evidence chains + recompute-not-trust verify on every artifact-receiving boundary prevent tamper.

non_repudiation.rationale: JSONL append-only evidence trail with fsync per record gives a per-event audit log that cannot be silently rewritten.

accountability.rationale: Every cross-AI review records implementer/reviewer provider + thread id + verdict; audit trail in PR squash messages.

authenticity.rationale: Cross-AI HARD RULE pins implementer provider != reviewer provider; same-provider review cannot fake independence.

resistance.rationale: AST import-allowlist + 3 guard flags const false at the schema boundary + ao-release-gate diff scope filter reject scope-widening payloads.

modularity.rationale: Public facade + _internal split (D1) + < 800-line file budget enforce module boundaries.

reusability.rationale: Pure-core modules (notifier, run_governor, slice_evidence_registers, native_worker_import, quality_profile) take data in, return data out — reusable in any host.

analysability.rationale: Structured error codes + path-only secret-safe messages + JSONL evidence let any failure be diagnosed without re-running the code.

modifiability.rationale: Schemas + ADRs + plan docs capture every architectural commitment; the test suite catches regression on every change.

testability.rationale: Pure cores are direct call-and-assert testable; 85%+ branch coverage gate per module; AST import-allowlist tests pin structural purity.

adaptability.rationale: Workspace mode vs library mode + opt-in extras (llm, mcp, otel) let the same kernel run in different governance envelopes.

scalability.rationale: Single-process kernel; horizontal scaling lives in the calling host. No autoscaling claim within the shipped boundary.

installability.rationale: pip install ao-kernel — single PyPI artifact; CI extras-install job pins that every advertised extra installs cleanly.

replaceability.rationale: No legacy in-place upgrade contract; downstream callers pin a version and adopt new ones explicitly.
